reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 40 original B1/B2 verb exercises: checked full German sentences, conjugation, case and constructions, each offered distractor, unique accepted answers, bilingual feedback and distinct contexts. Reviewed source labels and production/initial/B2/workplace/general-expansion objectives; no identical verb-specific target mapped. Source sense and grammar distinctions recorded per row. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review pending. Second editorial pass clarified sculpture placement and unauthorized disclosure, and removed repetitive 'im Messprotokoll protokolliert' wording.
